projects.title: Open Tickets | Secure Software Design Class Group Project
projects.description: An open source IT Ticket Management system designed to be fully self-hostable. Web frontend and Python backend with database services through MySQL. For this project I built the backend database handler and authenication. This was my first time building a fullstack app and it has taught me so much about backend and web systems. During the iterative design of the project I found and fixed various security vulnrabilies. This application was a team effort, and I learned valuable skills about managing a shared codebase. After the semester ended I wanted to continue project developmet, I made design documentation, started triaging issues and new features. Ultimately I had to indefidently pause development due to other commitments (College).

projects.title: Proxmox Homelab
projects.description: My homelab currently runs various services and VMs for NextCloud, Home Assistant and more. I've learned so much about linux systems administration from manging it. In the near future I intend to setup a IDS on the homelab and eventually also have it do network routing services.

projects.title: This Website
projects.description: This entire website has been made from scratch and is hosted on github pages. The website makes heavy use of Github Workflows to automatically handle static HTML embeding and generating feeds. Accessability and no-script compatability was part of its core design.
